kind.description: antd Menu — navigation. `items` are inline nav entries: a `label`+`path` makes a visible sidebar entry and a route; a label-less item is a route-only (hidden) route. Content resolves by resourceRefId or the flexes/page-<slug> convention.

allowedResources.description: the list of resources that are allowed to be children of this widget or referenced by it

items.description: navigation entries (inline nav data); each references its content widget by resourceRefId or resolves via the path → flexes/page-<slug> convention. A label-less item registers a route with no sidebar entry.

path.description: route path; '{param}' segments become :param and reach the content widget via ?extras. A label-less item registers a route with NO sidebar entry (hidden — e.g. detail/create/search).

label.description: menu entry label; omit for a route-only (hidden) item

icon.description: FontAwesome icon name shown beside the label (e.g. 'fa-inbox')

resourceRefId.description: id of the content widget (resolved via resourcesRefs, RBAC-aware). Optional — omit to use the path → flexes/page-<slug> convention.

page.description: convention page-slug override → content is flexes/page-<slug>; set this for templated paths to avoid list-vs-detail collisions.

type.description: set to 'divider' to render a visual separator at this order position; no path or label needed

widgetData.description: The properties Menu renders. Where Menu wraps an antd component these are antd's own prop names, so antd's documentation for that component describes them.

name.description: Name of the RESTAction resource to call.

apiRef.description: Binds this widget to a RESTAction whose response feeds the widgetDataTemplate and resourcesRefsTemplate expressions. Omit it for a widget whose data is entirely static.

forPath.description: Dot-path inside widgetData whose value this expression replaces, for example `items[0].title`.

expression.description: A jq expression evaluated server-side against the apiRef response. Its result replaces the value at forPath.

widgetDataTemplate.description: Per-field overrides evaluated against the apiRef response, so one authored widget can render live cluster data. Each entry replaces one value inside widgetData.

allowed.description: Set server-side: whether the caller may perform this verb. False entries are stripped before the widget renders and are never authored by hand.

apiVersion.description: Group and version of the referenced resource, for example `widgets.templates.krateo.io/v1beta1`.

id.description: The author-chosen handle this widget uses to reference the resource, matching a resourceRefId in widgetData.

payload.description: Body sent with a mutating verb. Ignored for a GET.

verb.description: HTTP verb used to resolve the reference. GET for a read; a mutating verb makes this a write the widget can dispatch.

offset.description: Number of items to skip before the returned page.

perPage.description: Maximum items in the returned page.

continue.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous response, used to fetch the next page.

slice.description: Server-side paging for this reference: the widget receives one page rather than the whole list.

items.description: One referenced resource. The widget addresses it by its `id`, never by name.

resourcesRefs.description: The resources this widget references by id. Each entry is resolved server-side and its endpoint handed to the widget; entries the caller may not read are removed before the widget renders, so a denied reference reads as absence rather than as an error.

iterator.description: A jq expression selecting the array in the apiRef response to iterate over.

apiVersion.description: Group and version of the referenced resource, for example `widgets.templates.krateo.io/v1beta1`.

id.description: The author-chosen handle this widget uses to reference the resource, matching a resourceRefId in widgetData.

payload.description: Body sent with a mutating verb. Ignored for a GET.

verb.description: HTTP verb used to resolve the reference. GET for a read; a mutating verb makes this a write the widget can dispatch.

template.description: The resourcesRefs entry emitted for each iterated element; its fields may interpolate that element.

resourcesRefsTemplate.description: Generates resourcesRefs entries from the apiRef response — one per element the iterator yields — so a widget can reference a list whose length it does not know when authored.

spec.description: The widget's contract: its own data, an optional binding to a RESTAction, the resources it references, and any templated overrides.
